newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA COUNT ON STOICHKOV AGAINST ISRAEL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA COUNT ON STOICHKOV AGAINST ISRAEL.

text.p: Bulgaria coach Hristo Bonev on Friday announced his squad for a World Cup qualifier against Israel on August 20 and said he hoped Hristo Stoichkov would be fit to play.
Local newspapers said Stoichkov, who plays for Barcelona in Spain, was in hospital with a high temperature.
"I do not know Stoichkov's problems but I hope he will recover quickly and will be ready for August 20," sports daily Meridian Match quoted Bonev as saying.
So far in the European qualifying group five, Bulgaria have lost 2-1 to Israel but won their four matches against Cyprus and Luxembourg.
Bulgaria are third in the standings with 12 points from five games while Russia are top with 14 points from six games. Israel have 13 points from seven games.
Bulgaria play Russia in Sofia on September 10 and in Moscow on October 11.
Defenders - Trifon Ivanov, Anatoli Nankov, Ivailo Petkov, Ivailo Yordanov, Georgi Antonov, Gosho Ginchev, Stanimir Gospodinov, Georgi Markov
Midfielders - Zlatko Yankov, Radostin Kishishev, Daniel Borimirov, Yordan Lechkov, Ilia Gruev
Strikers - Krasimir Balakov, Hristo Stoichkov, Lyubomir Penev, Emil Kostadinov, Georgi Donkov.
